system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform action: Sends OTP for iFMS fertilizer subsidy authentication. For your information, my mobile_number is 9876574301, my aadhaar_number is 100020002761.

function.name: ifms_initiate_purchase
function.description: Initiates a fertilizer purchase transaction at an authorized retailer. Transitions transaction_status to 'initiated'. Farmer must be authenticated via Aadhaar at point of sale. Requires session_token. Does NOT complete purchase or apply subsidy. Fails if retailer not authorized, farmer not eligible, Aadhaar authentication invalid at POS, or quantity exceeds season limits.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

retailer_id.description: Unique identifier of the authorized fertilizer retailer.

function.name: ifms_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for iFMS fertilizer subsidy authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.
